reviews.review_text:
ArseneL
Auckland11 contributions

Beautiful location and great experience
Oct 2026 • Couples
We visited Chahn Bistro Rooftop yesterday, Friday 2 October, after spending much of the day on a rather unusual mission: finding a good chicken-breast-based meal for my lovely wife online.
We eventually found two meals that met her very specific requirement, but the team at Chahn Bistro went out of their way to make sure her birthday dinner was exactly what she wanted. I chose the salmon from the menu, which was absolutely delicious as well.
The staff were genuinely friendly and attentive, the rooftop setting was beautiful, and the atmosphere was just right. We were told that locals tend to dine earlier, so after 8 pm the place becomes pleasantly quiet; and that turned out to be perfect for us.
We ended up spending a wonderful 90–120 minutes on the rooftop, enjoying our dinner, talking, laughing and simply smiling at each other. It was one of those unexpectedly lovely moments that makes a holiday special.
A beautiful place, wonderful people and a very memorable evening. We would happily come back

Nice cosy restaurant with a view. Love the lights. Nice for a date night or a quiet meal. Book as there are not many tables.
Jan 2023 • Solo
Rooftop dining with a view. It is noisy due to the roads below but the lights and music are very romantic. Good for a date night or quiet meal (quiet meaning a few close friends rather than a big group). Book as there are not many tables. Very cosy and sexy. Clean. Nice atmosphere. Loved the light music. Fast wifi. Most of the seating is covered but some is open. Take a throw incase. Attracts mainly tourists. They do brunch, there are set menus plus a la carte for lunch and dinner. Very Western. I had the Grilled Octopus Romesco which was very nice. Light and well presented as I wanted. The romesco could have been spicier but this is more a preference and it was good. As I wanted. Great service. Menu is in English too. I went early for dinner but the restaurant quickly filled up. Tempted to come back for lunch. Would recommend. You can book by messaging them on instagram. They respond quickly. There is a lift to take you up so don't worry.

kaduzy

Very poor service
May 2022
I was not satisfied with the service provided. I had to ask for almost everything twice, and when I pointed out to the server that he'd forgotten the bread tray that was included in my meal, he blamed me and said I didn't get it because I didn't tell him which option I wanted. It's the server's job to present the options and ask which one I want, not my job to know in advance that there are options when I've never eaten there before in my life, and then magically ask him about it. Ridiculous. I waited so long for my dessert that I literally fell asleep at the table, then woke up and waited some more. Finally I went ahead and asked for that as well. I asked the women dining next to me if they had had to ask too, and they said they did. So at least it wasn't just me! On top of that, the white wine offered with the Free Flow was served from an open carafe instead of a bottle, which is a horrible way to serve a white wine. The air exposure absolutely ruins it, which partially explains the taste. I switched to gin tonics. When I asked the server what kind of wine it was, he said "White." I said, "Yes, that's quite obvious, I mean what TYPE of white wine is it? Where's it from?" He just said, "France" and ignored the other question. Did not offer to show me a bottle, likely because it came from a box. The last straw was that I asked for my dishes to be brought out separately but he brought them both at once, ensuring that the second one would be cold. Definitely will not return!

reviews.review_text:
Guidoflyer
Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam8 contributions
1
Chanh Bistro is expanding, for all the right reasons.....Excellence!!
Sep 2019
For many years, I have dined at their original location, near the Bitexco Tower. Without exception, my family, friends and colleagues have had great experiences. It has become one of my 1st choices, when looking to make a special event become an extraordinary experience. The new Bistro still has wonderful views of the city, and a more contemporary feel tableside. 

The Bistro has revamped their menu, keeping some their signature dishes and adding many European and Vietnamese items that are both vegetarian and child friendly. We were eating lightly for a luncheon, so I opted for a squid salad. In a word, magnifique! The greens were fresh and crispy, served chilled. The squid was the superstar; when cooked, it can easily become tough, or rubbery. Every slice was grilled to perfection; soft and tender, but not mushy...the citrus dressing complimented all of the salad's ingredients, that gave balance throughout.

The others at our table unanimously went for beetroot marinated salmon, one of the Bistro's signature entrees. It is really out of this world! Although I was a spectator, I recalled many memories of the dish at past special events. Everyone really liked their meals, and thought that the combined ingredients at 1st glance seemed unusual. But they really were delicious combined. There is nothing nicer for foodies than getting an unexpected yummy surprise :-)

The service was very good.....English was spoken very well, and we had no mistaken orders. IMHO, however, the staff needs a bit more training to learn the subtle differences between Western & Asian dining expectations. 

Ahhh, the environment!! The 1st Bistro has been known as a landmark location for special events. Their newest rooftop location will continue to set the standard for Saigon roof terrace dining. The building has fewer floors, so you're closer to the street. Traffic noise is louder, obviously. I personally like to hear (and take a look at) all the commotion for a little while. It may annoy others. Also, Saigon's rooftop establishments ALL have little accommodation for mobility impaired diners, or young families.

Regarding price, I think The Bistro is a great value; the portions are ample, the food quality is 1st class, the staff are friendly & genuine, and exceptional views are priceless.

Dear NathanaelO16 - Thanks for your comments. We probably did not have a good night and you were not in the best of the moods. Our foie gras is high quality imported from France and food imports are subject to high import taxes, hence surely you cannot expect the same quantity on a dish as you would expect overseas. We prepare it lightly pan-fried at the last minute, which is one traditional way to cook it, and accommodate it with a fruit sauce on the side and home made slow fermentation bread. Same for the ingredients we use: carefully selected from safe sources. This comes at a cost. Now the vast majority of our customers comment there is too much or far enough food on their plate. About the chocolate fondant (and thanks for your good comment on it) which took so much time to get to your table: we bake these at the last minute (which is the only way to have the fondant effect and the taste) and sometimes (as high as 1 times out of 10), because it is still fondant, the cake sticks to the mold and it is not presentable. So our kitchen team has to another one (which takes 15-20 mins as advised on the menu and normally mentioned by the waiter when ordering). This is why you had to wait that long. The waiter should have explained that to you as it was taking longer. This is not an excuse, but at least now you have the explanation, and we hope you can accept our apologies for this. Sorry you did not enjoy it as much as most of our customers. We do like to see our guest happy while at our rooftop restaurant and after - I hope you give us another try and if you do please contact me in advance, I will make sure you are treated with extra care.

Customer Service Issue Marred the Visit
Dec 2018 • Couples
The food in this restaurant is very good - well cooked, well seasoned, well presented. Service was pleasant and friendly. The view from the terrace is less spectacular than it looks in the advertisements, looking down onto a busy and fairly ugly street, but the ambience is pleasant nonetheless. 

We had one major issue which definitely marred the evening. Knowing Christmas night would be busy, I booked a month in advance, but when we arrived we were met on the stairs by a staff member with a list of reservations and ours wasn't on it. I told them I had booked with them in advance and had correspondence from them to that effect. I was asked to show it, and we had to sit in a lower room, while I got online and found the correspondence. The staff member then went off and eventually came back and we were brought up to a table that had clearly been hurriedly set up as I was sitting cheek by jowl with a Christmas tree and had to move a string of lights so I could sit down. I then had the wrong starter delivered to the table, but chose to take it rather than wait longer for the food. 

The feeling of being put into a room downstairs and made to prove that I wasn't lying about the reservation left a bad taste in the mouth before even entering the restaurant. And considering the starter mistake, the cramped table and the botched reservation I thought they might perhaps have comped a dessert or even a coffee? Or maybe they could have removed the 5% service charge considering the service issues? But no, we were charged the full amount, which I think was poor form considering the circumstances.

Oct 2018 • Business
My friend and I, visiting from Hawaii, wanted to return to Chanh Bistro because our last visit was superb. Upon walking proximity, we were sadden to see the lights off on the roof top but wanted to verify it actually being closed. So we proceeded and once there asked around and verified that it was indeed closed. 

Bummed for a bit, to our delight there was a sign stating that the restaurant was being renovated but their other location was open. Finding out that it was close by, a person that was standing guard turns out to be employed by Chanh, helped us get a taxi and around 8 minutes later we arrived to being greeted by another staff member whom took care of our taxi bill...AWESOME!

Now that we arrived, we were pleasantly surprised that this place resembled the feel of the old place over looking the city with the great outdoor view and classy decor. The servers were welcoming, polite, prompt and pleasant even pouring our drinks for us each time while always smiling. I genuinely felt that they were happy to serve on us. 

I ordered the Ribeye steak (pepper-style) with salad and vegetables and can definitely say this is my best steak I've had in Vietnam. So tender and juicy without all that fat that tends to be a characteristic of an ribeye. I highly recommend it and would order it again on our next visit. 

Besides all the awesome wait help, I'd like to mention Hai for ensuring that we had another extra ordinary experience.

Good restaurant - weirdly portioned dessert
Jul 2018 • Couples
I overall liked this restaurant. We found it because my partner and I wanted a nice restaurant for our last night in ho chi minh that catered to vegetarians. Our mains were lovely and they had a nice range of options for us. Service was excellent. Only dissapointment was our dessert. I ordered the chocolate fondant cake- which was the most expensive item on the dessert menu. When it arrived I almost laughed. It was the tiniest thing I had ever seen. Now i didn't expect a huge dessert or anything- but it was so tiny that the one scoop of icecream that came with it was bigger than the entire fondant. It tasted nice but was really dissapointing on the portion especially when paying 125000 vd for it!

Other than the dissapointing dessert i couldn't fault the restaurant.

Review collected in partnership with this restaurant 
Written July 25, 2018
Owner's R
Dear Kassidy F, 

Thanks for your kind review and constructive comments. Glad you found here the vegetarian options you wanted - our chef has designed a few that we believe are interesting. As to the size of the chocolate fondant, our kitchen has always served used the same mold since we first put this desert item on our menu about 3 years ago, and you are the first one to flag this. Hence I am investigating to verify whether something exceptional came up that could explain the smaller size. We have sized and priced this item to reflect the quality of the ingredients we use for it, and the appetite of our guests at the end of a meal here. We use premium imported dark chocolate. Each chocolate fondant we serve is baked upon order (which explain why our menu and our waiters flag it normally takes 15-20 mins from order to be served), so it is freshly made and melting on your plate when you dig your spoon into it. Glad you enjoyed the taste. I would be grateful if you could send me a note at contact@chanhbistro.com referring to my note here so I can share with you the result of our investigation, and perhaps treat you upon your next visit to our rooftop restaurant. 

We look forward to seeing you on again here our rooftop at some point in the future.

Have a great day!

reviews.review_text:

Beijing, China11 contributions
0
Decent drinks. Food is average.
Feb 2018 • Friends
The location of this restaurant is really nice and has a great view of your surroundings. Just above you there is the BITEXCO building that dominates the skylines and Saigon and it really is a site. 

Our pumpkin soup we had was quite delicious and was very nicely presented. However, the choice of garlic bread as an accompaniment was a little bit puzzling. 

The drinks we had were also to a really high standard. The jasmine ipa was refreshing and my lychee martini was very tasty. 

But it was our steaks that left us very disappointed. For the price you pay for the steak you would expect it to be cooked to how you ask. We asked for medium rare and medium respectively but received rare and medium rare. Also both sauces were overpowering the meat so we decided to leave them be. 

If you want a place for a nice drink then this is perfect. But if you want a 3 course meal I would skip it.
Read more
Written February 16, 2018
Owner's R
Dear Luke R

Thanks for your visit to our rooftop. Thanks for your positive comments on the view, and the drinks and some of the dishes you had. We are sorry to your experience of our rooftop was not to your expectation. 

We took some time to review what happened, a bit longer than it would normally do given the lunar new year (Tet) holiday.

We see your friend also posted a copycat version of this review, and regret you did not provide your feedback to our manager when he asked you how things were going after your main course arrived to your table and your responded all was good. 

You came to our rooftop bistro on the lunar new year’s eve, in the middle of the lunar year holiday, while the whole country including most restaurants was on holiday resting and celebrating and most of our team was working hard to serve customers (including you and your friend) during long hours. We would have hoped your could have taken this into consideration when drafting your review and setting your rating. 

We are a family run business and work very hard on delivering good food and services at the right price, improving and rectify in case of shortfalls. We do appreciate constructive comments. Reviewing yours, we thank you for your good words about our place, cocktails and soup, and would like to address some of your other comments as follows:

- Side garlic bread on the side of the soup that are too greasy: these come for free, slices of bread spread with butter and garlic. Butter is indeed a bit greasy. Most or our customers like the side garlic breads that come with the soup. 
- Undercooked steaks: this unfortunately happen, and sometimes how a steak should be cooked is a relative science with different standards from different countries. We happily and easily recook any undercooked steak should the customer ask. Here unfortunately you did not ask, and did not mention anything when our manager asked you how main was. 
- Sauce on the side of the steak was “overpowering”: our sauces for steaks are made with natural ingredients (mushroom, pepper, wine) and normally a right fit for beef. The sauces are served in relatively big sauce pots so each guest pus as much as he or she wants, and there is indeed plenty for the ones who like their steaks with a lot of sauce.
- High prices: the special Tet menus you had on the new year’s eve were sold VND749,000 (about USD32) or VND979,000 (about USD42). Each set menu included a starter, a main course and a dessert, a homemade welcome drink and digestive. All our steaks are imported from the US or Australia (depending on the cut). On a new year’s eve on the rooftop of a western restaurant in the center of the city where most restaurants are overbooked, on a day (as on any other public holiday in Vietnam) the labour law mandates employees must be paid four (4!) times their normal salary and the prices of all suppliers has up to tripled as time got closer to the lunar new year. On this your comment is not very fair. 

We are sorry your friend felt discriminated due to our staff addressing to him in Vietnamese (because he looks Asian) rather than English as a start. No offence was intended, really, and we are surprised your friend felt that way. 

Our restaurant was very busy that night of the lunar new year’s eve, with people of all origins and nationality celebrating and enjoying their time, waiting to the midnight fireworks on our rooftop (which was great place to watch it) and having fun until late. We are sorry you were not in that mood and regret you did not have a time as nice as you could. 

We wish you a happy new year of the dog, and happy and safe travel as you are continuing your trip. 

Kind regards,

reviews.review_text:
Rajmathie J
Hong Kong, China17 contributions
0
Great food and brilliant service in harmony
Jul 2017
It was a birthday, and we wanted to have dinner at a nice restaurant to celebrate as a family. I read quite a few reviews and decided on Chanh Bistro Saigon. It was a fantastic evening with really great food and service. It was worth every penny spent and we would most certainly go back.
I had the pan cooked duck breast, which was beautifully presented and cooked to perfection. This was served with a beetroot puree which made the combination of flavours perfect, along with the right amount of roasted baby potatoes and vegetables. My husband had the seafood with ratatouille, which was very flavourful and once again cooked perfectly. The combination of flavours just kept it interesting right till the last bite. Our 9 year old decided on the spinach ravioli after some convincing from me..... he absolutely loved it! They didn't skimp on the spinach either. You could really taste the fact it was cooked with love. Our 6 year old had the carbonara.... this is a relatively simple preparation though its not tough to get it wrong.... They didn't! It had the right amount of everything and my husband and I did steal a few bites as we knew he couldn't finish the portion. 
For dessert I had the chocolate fondant with a scoop of vanilla ice cream, and it was heavenly! Not too sweet and perfectly chocolatey! Warm and firm on the outside and perfectly melting texture on the inside. I eat healthy and I am very specific on my treats..... this was well worth it! My husband had the crème brule which was really good too. The kids had ice cream.
The service from beginning to end was very personal and warm. Pleasantly surprising and exceeded our expectations on their service. 
It's not always you find a perfect, personal and thought after dining experience in a lovely setting, with fabulous food which looked amazing and tasted fabulous!

We had a wonderful evening and look forward to our next visit to Chanh Bistro.

reviews.review_text:

Valentine's Day meal
Feb 2017 • Couples
I had read favourable reviews of Chanh bistro before leaving the UK and as Valentine's Day fell during our stay in Saigon I thought it could be an option for a nice meal together. Anyway time passed and due to one thing and another I never got anything booked. So the night before valentines I emailed and asked if they had any specials etc and a table for 2, in no time at all I had a reply with a delicious sounding and very reasonably priced set menu attached and offer of a table at 7:30 which I jumped at. We decided to stop in for a cocktail that night also and just familiarise ourselves with the location etc. Cocktails were delicious and reasonably priced for such a lovely setting, staff were exceptionally friendly and although not all of their English was great we communicated just fine! So onto the valentines meal, I had beef salad, duck breast and cheesecake chocolate bomb with my girlfriend having the same but with pumpkin soup starter. My beef salad was excellent and a huge portion, I noticed a few locals who didn't get anywhere near to finishing it but being a greedy westerner I cleared the plate, fantastic combination of flavours and tender fresh thin slices of seasoned beef. Pumpkin soup also went down very well. The place was busy and we had a small wait for our mains which was fine by us although the owner was quick to apologise but as I say it was not a problem! The duck was worth the wait, a nice sized piece of perfectly cooked duck breast with a selection of assortments that complimented it perfectly! Finally the dessert, well what a way to finish.. I had seen the picture of it but couldn't quite figure out what each bit was and the description was unclear, well a very pleasant surprise was that the chocolate bomb was filled with delicious creamy cheesecake filling! Wow! Our bill with wine and beer was under £50 which as any Brit will know is a bargain on Valentine's Day, most pubs by usually want similar money for much much lower standard food! And the friendly service here really was icing on the cake. I am also led to believe that the place is locally run or family run, basically not a big company, which is great to see in Saigon, keep up the good work!!

Owner's R
Dear mayvilla - Many thanks for your repeated visits on our rooftop and your confidence. I believe you came on the 28th of September and raised your concern about the meat with our manager. We offered to change the dish, but you refused. Indeed there was an issue with that batch of beef, that we identified thanks to you and immediately changed. That supplier is now under close monitoring. This is unfortunate but regrettably unavoidable. This is why we pay attention to the comments of our customers and ask for feedback. Thank you for that one. Similarly we would have liked to hear from you any concerns you may have had about the prawns with mango salsa dish. The quantities and quality of that dish has not changed since we started: 4 or 5 prawns depending on the size of the prawns. Hence I am very surprised to hear this - now there may have been a mistake made in the kitchen and this is why getting your comment on the spot would have enabled us to rectify immediately. As to the space you need on the table, our customers usually enjoy the setting up. We always offer to dress a side table or stool when people order wine bottles or champagne, with a ice bucket when it needs to be kept chilled. We hope to see you again soon, for lunch, brunch, drinks (including for our daily happy hour from 2 to 7pm with buy 1 get 2 on cocktails, spirits+mixer and house wine by the glass) or dinner. Ambience was better than food
Apr 2016 • Couples
We decided to have dinner at this bistro located on the top floor of a nondescript building which could be easily missed except for staff standing outside the building. Staff were friendly and showed us the way to the lift and stairs to the bistro.

First impression was nice: garden setting with tables and chairs at the rooftop terrace with a view of the iconic Bitexco Financial Tower (Lotus Building) and night scene.

We were given complimentary ginger ale while perusing the menu. We decided to share half dozen oysters as starters. They were fresh, not particularly big but tasted fine. For our main course, my husband chose barbequed lamb chops with ratatouille vegetables while I opted for beef rib eye served with french fries and salad. Both dishes looked nicer than they tasted as the meat was tough which seems to be the case in most restaurants in HCM city. Maybe the local people like their meat to be chewy, but not us.

We also ordered a bottle of red wine costing VND 480,000 which was reasonable. Desserts of creme brulee and warm chocolate with vanilla ice cream were delicious.

One particular wait-staff, a young man, was very helpful and his English was slightly better than other staff. The French owner of the bistro even stopped by to say hello to us and enquired about our meal.

Ambience was good although we didn't particularly like the techno music. A number of people were only there for drinks as it offers a lovely view of the city at night.

Total bill for dinner comprising one starter, two mains, two desserts, bottle of wine including service charge and VAT came to VND1.825 million which we felt was a bit high for HCM city but reasonable compared to Singapore's prices.

Written April 26, 2016
Owner's R
Dear teaganw17 - Thanks for your feedback. We take all reviews very seriously. Service is normally prompt at our restaurant. Hence we immediately investigated your case. Our findings below are based on a debrief with our team and a review of the logs of our ordering system (POS), and is confirmed by the video recording of the camera system (which has a time dater). 

You came the day before yesterday, 27 April:
2:16pm: you arrived, alone. There were two tables of guests. You ordered your drink (mixed fruit juice without ice) immediately, but at that time you did NOT order any food.
2:20pm: your drink was served at your table.
2:26pm: you ordered a bruschetta platter (VND60,000, i.e. about USD2.6) and specified that it should NOT come right away. 
2:32pm: you asked the waiter to bring your food. 
2:38pm: you called the waiter to ask again for your bruschetta platter. This was the time the guests of one of the two other tables left our restaurant. 
2:41pm: the bruschetta platter was served to your table. 
2:48pm: you asked for the bill at the cashier, and you got it right away.
2:50pm: you entered the lift to leave the restaurant. 

Hence we believe it is not fair to write in your review that “it took 30 minutes for the food to come out, after twice asking for it”. It only took 9 minutes from the time your requested your food (and in any case only 13 minutes from the time you ordered with the special instruction NOT to bring the food right away). 

You wrote “when paying the bill it took quite some time”, but your asked for your bill at 14:48pm at the cashier, and the bill was on your hand right away at 14:48pm. You left and you were though in the lift on your way down at 14:50pm. We really do not understand your comment here either.

In conclusion, we query the genuineness of your comments and what motivated your review. 

Thanks anyway for having pointed out that our bruschetta are tasty.

Regards, 
Phuong

reviews.review_text:
Del E
Vietnam110 contributions
0
Smokers a problem
Feb 2016 • Couples
OK my quick review of Chanh Bistro which has had a bit of airplay on here recently.

This was probably clouded going on Valentine's Day which I would expect to be busy, but one thing was inexcusable and pretty much destroyed our entire evening: The advertising says "two rooftop terraces and a mix of inside airconditioned and outside areas" and this is in fact incorrect. The inside area is not airconditioned, there are only fans in the roof. It is also open to the outside, and in any case apart from a few inside tables, nearly all of the tables are outside. Of course the entire outside area is a smoking area and rather than corral the few smokers by having a smoking area and a non-smoking area, they have the smokers scattered throughout the entire outside area. This may not seem like a big issue for an outside area but there is actually limited air circulation because the outside area is enclosed on 2 sides -- one side of which is the indoor area. So unless you enjoy gulping cigarette smoke between bites of your meal, do not go here.

Food: Steak was good. Not the best steak I've had but nicely cooked. I ordered rare and got it, which is uncommon in Saigon. Seafood plate was also good although the fish was a little salty. I couldn't identify the fish, it was an ocean fish, perhaps sea bass or ocean trout. The chef claims not to have added salt so it was probably just a naturally salty fish, could have done with a 5 minute blanching before cooking.

Dessert: Chocolate pudding was a little overcooked on the outside giving a slightly charred flavour which was unpleasant but it was nice on the inside. The ice creams were good, I suspect home made.

Service: Attentive although a little slow. This was excusable on such a busy night. We were offered a free glass of wine as recompense which was nice. However, after having issues with the smokers outside we asked to be moved inside and were told there were no tables (despite the fact that I could see 2 empty ones). So I got a bit petulant and shouty and we were finally moved to an inside table. Twice after that a server came to our table and told us that they had found a table outside for us so we could move out there. I explained on each time that we didn't want to sit next to people smoking, and we had specifically asked to move inside but that didn't seem to go down too well. So clearly the service staff here have no issues with the smoking setup.

Food: 8/10 would eat again.
Service: 5/10 listen up please people.
Atmosphere (cough cough): 1/10 would not go back.

Written February 15, 2016
Owner's R
Dear Del Elson - thanks for your visit last night and comments. We value reviews and always use them to improve. I would like to respond and comment as follows:
1. Air-conditioned areas: we do have AC areas (including the main area where you ended sitting). Thanks to sliding window doors on the whole length, we transform the inside area into an open area to the outside terrace late in the afternoon when the temperature cools down and the fresh breezes start, as the vast majority of our guests enjoy the outside area concept. Now it is true that the description you quoted is incorrect. We managed to find where you found it (on a web site under construction and we have amend it. We note that the descriptions of our bistro on TripAdvisor, Google and Facebook are all accurate). Is this really “ inexcusable”? We note that the AC is on at lunch time every day (when indeed it is hot and it would make no sense to not offer AC), but some of our guests still sit on the outside terrace that is in the shade for lunch. 
2. Changing table: you did not specify when you booked your table that you expected a non-smoking table. Our restaurant was fully booked on that night (Valentine day) and as you had booked early we reserved for you a table outside, which is what our guests normally prefer. You asked to the waiter to be moved inside when you were here, and indeed he told you this would be an issue as we were fully booked and all the tables inside were also booked, waiting for guests with reservations to come at a later time of the evening. As some guests had come and left early, our team managed to rearrange the sitting plan (including moved bookings of tables inside to outside) and transfer you to a table inside. As more guests had left and I wanted to please the guests who were sitting inside (as most people indeed prefer to sit outside), I went to you to offer you to move to outside. I did not know you had been moved from outside to inside at your earlier request, and should have consulted with my team before doing so. I understand that you felt it is a serious issue: you had to repeat yourself and got irritated about it, so please accept my apologies again for this. 
3. Smocking area: we do not allow people to smoke in the inside areas, even when the sliding window doors are open. We currently do not prevent our guests sitting outside from smocking. We noted and are considering your suggestion to have dedicated non-smoking areas on our terraces. The outside terrace area is enclosed on 1 side only, the one side of which is the indoor area (that has ceiling fans as you mentioned) and that allows a natural ventilation from the back of the building (where we open doors and windows) toward the terrace. I do not smoke and am very sensitive to and highly dislike cigarette smoke myself; I dine outside on the terrace quite frequently with my young daughter, but have never been annoyed by smokers or felt that cigarette smoke was an issue. Again last night the terrace was full and the valentines dining outside may have been heavy smokers. Sorry also for this as it caused you discomfort. 
4. Service: many thanks for noting the service was attentive, despite the restaurant was fully booked (both floors). Thanks also for noting that we accommodated your request to change table in the middle of the rush. Glad you enjoyed the glass of wine on the house. Of course busy nights like the Valentine day dinner are a bit challenging, but our guests generally find our service friendly and like it. 
5. Food: As my husband confirmed to you on the spot after having checked with the chef, our kitchen does not had salt to the fish or seafood we serve. The fish that comes with the grilled seafood dish you ordered is tuna. Over saltiness of tuna may happen, but we do not believe blanching is right for tuna. That said we have since your comment last night and will continue to carefully monitor this with samples to ensure the fish on that dish is not too salty. Chocolate fondant is made at the last minute (which explains why it takes 20 mins to prepare as is noted on the menu) and is served melting inside. The outside needs to be more cooked than the inside. Glad you enjoyed the melting part and the side ice-cream. Thanks for your good comment about the rib-eye steak and for noting the way it was cooked exactly as you had ordered it. 

As a conclusion, we are very sorry the issues you pointed out altered your experience, and we hope you will give us another chance. We wish our happy guests commented on their good experience at our rooftop bistro as often as people comment on their not so good experience. We value the comments of all our guests including yours and take them into consideration to continue improving and offering quality services and food at the right price, with all the heart of our team members. Have a great day and happy eating! Phuong - Chanh Bistro Rooftop Saigon, 45 Ho Tung Mau street, D1, HCMC (opposite the entrance of the Sky Deck of the Bitexco Financial Tower).

Written December 24, 2015
Owner's R
Dear salvatoremichel - season’s greetings! Thanks for taking the time to post this review. However we do not believe your review/rating is complete/fair, and we regret you posted as such. 

Your group booked a table for X-mas eve for 10, then 20, then 25 people, and eventually 34 people turned up! Booking was for 8pm, and most of your group arrived after 9pm (when most of our other guests that night ordered too). As a result our kitchen got under stress, and surely there were delays (never experienced before) in bringing food to your tables. Our kitchen always makes a point of serving excellent food: this is why it took so long as we did not compromise on quality (we note your review omits to discuss the quality of the food you had). 

As to quantities of our servings, our customers generally comment that there is too much on their plate. Your group seemed to have enjoyed a pretty good time - our team and manager regularly checked (given the delays) and received reasonably positive comments in the circumstances. 

You will recall that my husband offered to your group free bottles of wine and free Tiger draft beers as an attempt to compensate for the wait time and to keep up the good spirit of the Christmas eve. 

For your bill of VND1 mil (USD44) you either had (i) the VND499k festive menu with oysters or home marinated salmon etc. and duck breast dish or else as main plus many orders of drinks of the side, or (ii) the VND810k more expensive festive menu that comes with foie gras and premium imported lamb rack or rib-eye dish and some orders of drinks of the side (noting that each of these festive menus come with a welcome drink, a glass of wine, a digestive and of course a choice of desert). Beyond these details you will see that almost all reviewers considers our offer is affordable. 

Finally as to your reference to the payment of the bill: yes indeed our team struggled spitting the bill for each of the 34 guests (!) of your group as per request - this is unfortunate and disappointing - as disappointing as the fact that a number of the MEMBERS OF YOUR GROUP LEFT WITHOUT PAYING FOR THEIR MEAL/DRINKS WITHOUT REASON OR EXPLANATION (a shortfall of about USD200 in the end, that we have to absorb). 

We have learnt a lot from that Xmas eve, and the mistakes made will not be replicated. We shall continue to deliver quality Western international food and drinks in a pleasant environment. We hope to get a chance to serving you again, and wish you a happy holiday seasons. 

Regards, Phuong - Chanh Bistro Rooftop Saigon, 45 Ho Tung Mau street, D1, HCMC (opposite the entrance of the Sky Deck of the Bitexco Tower).

Great Rooftop Ambience!

I had heard about Chanh Bistro some time ago but never had the opportunity to visit. I tend to stick to my regular haunts! But last evening I went and was absolutely delighted. I have seldom had a more 'comfortable' meal! Both floors are, in effect, rooftop with views of one of my favourite buildings - Times Square. You have to go through Passio on the ground floor entrance to get to the lift, but that is no inconvenience. Once there you are attended to and escorted to your table. I dined in the Bistro, not the 'Rooftop' and all the tables were nicely placed. You would feel comfortable whichever table you used! The menu is varied and interesting. I chose the Lamb Shank with Pommes Gratin. The lamb was tender and the Pommes - to die for! Very nicely served and sensible sized portions. Absolutely delicious! As a treat I had the Crème Brulee and what a treat it was! Perfect!! I had a carafe of wine and the amount was just right. I always need more than one glass (!!) and sometimes a bottle seems too much! The staff were conscientiously going about their duties of looking after everyone, including me! The pricing is, I believe, quite reasonable for the quality of food, wine and the setting. I have added Chanh Bistro to my regular list - I can't wait to go back! excellent!

Owner's R
Dear Thanh_Tu_N - thanks for your review. We appreciate your kind words about the quality of our food, drinks, view and music. You came (on Saturday 22 August 2015 at night) on the occasion of a jazz concert we organised with a famous band and the restaurant was completely FULL. We agree this is not an excuse and the delay in serving your dishes was unacceptably long. This is however an explanation: all the guests placed their order at the same time between 9pm and 9:30pm, which put our kitchen under an extreme stress. And while at a concert customer generally mainly order drinks, everyone drew on our good food and this caused some delays. Luckily you enjoyed a quality jazz concert in the meantime. Our manager and my husband came to your table several times to check on you, to update you on when your dishes would be ready, and to present our apologies. We learnt a lot for the future on that concert night! Luckily you enjoyed the food which is the most important thing to us. We would like to apologize again for the long service that night again, and hope you will give Chanh Bistro Rooftop Saigon another chance and come back enjoy our quality food and drinks on our pleasant rooftop.
